I saved Pree's note in GBrain as a fact on Marrow Agrisupply: the new inbound lane is at Dock 23. I credited it to Pree's #central-team message (ts 1791986400.000123). I also replied to Pree in that thread to say it's been noted.

Before saving, I checked GBrain for anything about this lane and found nothing that conflicts. The search ran on keywords only, so it might have missed notes that word things differently. There was no Marrow Agrisupply page to attach the fact to, so it's saved only as a fact, which is how GBrain stores remembered items anyway.

Nothing else was needed: no mail, no approvals, and no finance figures were involved.
